fields.acceptance: A Go test with an injected stat and exec: a changed executable triggers exec once, after the poll; an unchanged one never does; a pending start delays the exec to a later poll; the daemon lock is taken again by the new image
fields.statement: The daemon re-executes itself with the same arguments when its executable's size or modification time has changed since it started, checked at the end of a poll with no start pending, so a rebuilt rhiza takes over without a hand restart and live runs carry on

fields.acceptance: daemon-status.txtar shows a Version: line with the test build's version; describe-golden.txtar is regenerated for the new field
fields.statement: rhiza daemon status prints the version of the binary the daemon runs, recorded in the daemon's state when it starts or re-executes
